balancePriority.label: Balance prioritization
balancePriority.hint: With balance prioritization off, the task list sorts by the original priority again. The choice applies in this browser.

expertMode.label: Expert mode
expertMode.hint: Shows the advanced controls — the block below lists which areas they cover. Applies per device and is off by default.
expertMode.itemPillarShares: Pillar percentages in the task dialog (fine-tuning the shares)
expertMode.itemGeoRange: Range and interval in the “Location” tab (display distance, alarm distance, update interval)

voiceAutostart.hint: When you open the forms for creating and editing tasks and series, the first input field is focused and its microphone starts automatically.
voiceAutostart.deniedText: Access to the microphone was denied. Automatic voice recording stays off. Please grant the permission in your browser and try again.

motion.animationsHint: Show decorative animations — individually controlled via “Animate heart” and “Animate completion”. Applies per device and is off by default.
motion.reducedText: Your operating system is set to “Reduce motion”. Decorative animations (e.g. confetti) therefore stay off, regardless of the “Animations” switch.
motion.heartHint: The life balance heart on the dashboard beats and its water surface ripples. Requires the “Animations” switch. Applies per device.
motion.doneHint: Confetti rains when you complete tasks. Requires the “Animations” switch. Applies per device.

notifications.pushHint: Allow Balamentum to send you reminders (e.g. for due tasks) as push notifications – even when the app is not open.
notifications.pushFailedText: Push notifications could not be enabled. Please grant the notification permission in your browser and try again.
notifications.pushUnavailableText: This browser does not support push notifications. Install the app or use an up-to-date browser to receive reminders.
notifications.careHint: Gentle hints when a pillar falls clearly short or is overloaded – at most one per day, never at night. Only affects the care push: deadline reminders stay on.
notifications.saveFailedText: The setting could not be saved. Please check your connection and try again.
notifications.splitHintHint: Shows a friendly hint on the “Next task” card when you have repeatedly postponed several large tasks. The order of the recommendation does not change.
notifications.testNoneText: No device is reachable for this account. Turn push notifications off and on again.

pillars.fixedText: By definition, these 5 pillars address the balance in life and always apply. Your weighting stays individually adjustable.

geo.label: Track location
geo.hint: Determine your current position every {{minutes}} minutes (e.g. for location-based task suggestions).
geo.deniedText: Access to your location was denied. Location tracking stays off. Please grant the permission in your browser and try again.
geo.unavailableText: This browser does not support location queries. Use an up-to-date browser to determine your position.
geo.pwaLabel: Proximity alarm only while the app is open
geo.pwaText: Proximity alarms are only reliable while the app is open. In the browser, the background alarm may not fire — install Balamentum as an app so the proximity alarm arrives reliably.
geo.displayHint: Up to this distance, the “Nearby” list shows tasks. Currently {{km}} km.
geo.alarmHint: Within this distance of a task, the alarm hint appears. Currently {{km}} km.
geo.intervalHint: How often your position is determined in the background. Currently {{minutes}} minutes.

ai.planText: AI features (creation dialog with advisor, copy editing) are part of the “{{plan}}” plan.
ai.switchHint: With AI off, “Create new task” opens the full form directly; the copy-editing buttons are hidden. Existing access tokens stay valid.
ai.disabledText: The AI creation dialog (process and advise) and the copy-editing buttons are currently hidden. “Create new task” opens the full form directly.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.hint: Choose the app's color scheme. “System” follows your operating system's setting.

headerPosition.label: Header
headerPosition.hint: Sets whether the header sits at the top or bottom of the screen.

balanceVariant.label: Life balance image
balanceVariant.hint: All images show the same calculation: for each pillar, the ratio of actual to target — the strongest pillar always gets the largest shape. “Heart” fills a vessel; “Bubbles” and “Discs” stack the same shapes in two materials, “Rings” shows them as arcs, “Rays” as wedges of light. “Blossom” and “Crystal” merge all pillars into one silhouette — once soft, once angular. “Segments” divides the ring by actual shares, “Hands” shows one hand per pillar on the dial.

categoryDeleteDialog.title: Delete category
categoryDeleteDialog.body: Do you really want to delete the category “{{name}}”? Tasks and series in this category are kept and only lose their assignment.

llmProviderDeleteDialog.title: Delete provider
llmProviderDeleteDialog.body: Do you really want to delete the provider “{{name}}” ({{endpoint}})?
llmProviderDeleteDialog.activeHint: It is the ACTIVE provider — the fallback then takes over automatically (Mistral before OpenRouter, depending on the server ENV).

apiTokens.loadError: The token list could not be loaded.
apiTokens.title: Access tokens
apiTokens.intro: With an access token, you connect AI clients such as Claude to Balamentum.
apiTokens.createText: A token uses the same interfaces as this app — with your data and your permissions. The plain text is only visible right after creation.
apiTokens.createPlanText: Creating tokens is included from the {{plan}} plan.
apiTokens.readwritePlanText: Read and write is included from the {{plan}} plan.
apiTokens.headerConfig: Header configuration for external clients (e.g. Claude connector):
apiTokens.scopeHint: A token is read-only by default. Writing MCP tools such as task_create report an error as long as the switch is set to “Read only” — including tokens issued before this setting existed.
apiTokens.revokeQuestion: Really revoke? Clients will lose access.

calendarSources.loadError: The connected calendars could not be loaded.
calendarSources.title: Calendar
calendarSources.intro: Connect your calendar's ICS address — the events of the coming days appear in the week view.
calendarSources.passwordHint: An app password, not your main password. Read-only access.
calendarSources.removedText: The events have been removed from the week view.
calendarSources.empty: No calendar connected yet. Add your calendar's ICS address.
calendarSources.freeSlotHint: From this length on, the “Free time” card suggests matching tasks (10–240 minutes).
calendarSources.deleteBody: Really remove? The events of this calendar disappear from the week view.
calendarSources.deleteBodyCaldav: Really remove? The events of this calendar disappear from the week view and the credentials are deleted.

categoryList.intro: Categories group your tasks by topic — “House build”, “Taxes”, “Club”. Each task has at most one; it appears as a colored tag in the lists and can be filtered in search. Unlike a life pillar, it does not affect prioritization: pillars say what a task contributes to in your life (proportionally, several at once) and thus drive value and balance. Categories only say where something belongs by topic.
categoryList.emptyText: Create your first category to group tasks by topic. Without a category, tasks simply stay unsorted — nothing gets lost.

knowledgeEntries.loadError: The knowledge entries could not be loaded.
knowledgeEntries.title: Knowledge entries
knowledgeEntries.intro: Personal notes, e.g. “I don't train on Tuesdays”. Matching entries feed into the pillar assignment of new tasks.
knowledgeEntries.deleteBody: Really delete? The entry will no longer feed into the pillar assignment.

mcpInstructions.loadError: The dialog instructions could not be loaded.
mcpInstructions.title: Dialog instructions for the AI
mcpInstructions.intro: Applies to AI clients that connect via access token.
mcpInstructions.label: Instructions

llmSettings.loadError: The provider list could not be loaded.
llmSettings.title: AI provider
llmSettings.noProviderHint: No provider active — no ENV key for Mistral/OpenRouter is set and no custom provider is selected.
llmSettings.providerHint: Choose the provider for all AI requests. Without your own choice, the fallback takes over (Mistral before OpenRouter).
llmSettings.modelsFallbackHint: Live list unreachable — known standard models are offered.
llmSettings.modelsLiveHint: The models are loaded live from the selected provider.
llmSettings.readyText: All AI features run via {{name}} with model {{model}} (tested, {{latency}} ms).
llmSettings.failingText: {{name}} is active, but the test failed: {{message}}
llmSettings.untestedText: All AI features run via {{name}} with model {{model}}. Press “Test” below to actually check the connection.
llmSettings.noKeyBuiltin: No API key is stored on the server for {{name}} (ENV variable missing). Choose another provider or store the key on the server.
llmSettings.noKeyCustom: No API key is stored for {{name}} — edit the provider and enter the key.
llmSettings.noModel: Choose a model above, then all AI features are usable.

llmProviderForm.endpointInvalid: Endpoint must be a valid http(s) URL (e.g. https://api.mistral.ai/v1).
llmProviderForm.apiKeyEmpty: API key must not be empty when creating.
llmProviderForm.modelEmpty: Model must not be empty — not every provider offers a model list.
llmProviderForm.nameHint: Display name, e.g. z.ai or Groq
llmProviderForm.apiKeyHintEdit: Leave empty to keep the stored key unchanged.
llmProviderForm.modelHint: Model ID, e.g. glm-4.7 — can be changed later via the model list.

feedbackForm.required: Please fill in title and description.
feedbackForm.sent: Thank you! Your feedback has been sent.
feedbackForm.intro: Questions, wishes and ideas or bug reports go straight into the development team's notebook — no GitHub account needed.
feedbackForm.title: Title

pillarWeights.unbalancedHint: This distribution deviates strongly from an even one — pillars are usually weighted fairly evenly. This is only a hint: you can still save.
pillarWeights.intro: Distribute 100 % across the five pillars. When you move one slider, the others follow — each pillar keeps at least {{min}} %.

recalcPillar.title: Recalculate pillar distribution
recalcPillar.intro: The pillar contributions of the selected tasks are redetermined by AI based on title and description. Status, points and streak stay unchanged.
recalcPillar.quotaText: Each task is classified individually and counts against your monthly AI quota. Once it is used up, the run stops and reports what is still open.
recalcPillar.resumeHint: “Resume” only processes the open ones, including those that failed before.
recalcPillar.continuesOnServer: The run continues on the server even if you close this window.
recalcPillar.noTasks: There were no tasks to process with the selected filter.
recalcPillar.quotaExhaustedText: The run has stopped. {{open}} tasks are still open — it can be resumed in the next billing month or with a larger plan.
recalcPillar.pendingHint: {{pending}} tasks are still open. “Resume” only processes these, even later after a reload.
